usage: llm-modelbench rankings [-h] [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR] [--out OUT]
                               [--rescan] [--watch] [--interval INTERVAL]
                               [--exclude-model EXCLUDE_MODEL]
                               [--include-model INCLUDE_MODEL]
                               [--exclude-run EXCLUDE_RUN]
                               [--include-run INCLUDE_RUN]
                               [--archive-run ARCHIVE_RUN]
                               [--unarchive-run UNARCHIVE_RUN]
                               [--reason REASON] [--list-excluded]
                               [--include-separate] [--adopt ADOPT_CAMPAIGN]
                               [--dry-run]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR   where to read runs from
  --out OUT             generated rankings database directory
  --rescan              force every currently present run to be reread;
                        deleted-run history remains preserved
  --watch               keep rescanning for run/judge sidecar changes
  --interval INTERVAL   seconds between --watch scans
  --exclude-model EXCLUDE_MODEL
                        non-destructively hide one model name or digest from
                        this rankings output
  --include-model INCLUDE_MODEL
                        reverse --exclude-model for one model name or digest
  --exclude-run EXCLUDE_RUN
                        non-destructively hide one run ID from this rankings
                        output
  --include-run INCLUDE_RUN
                        reverse --exclude-run for one run ID
  --archive-run ARCHIVE_RUN
                        mark one run ID archived/hidden from normal rankings
  --unarchive-run UNARCHIVE_RUN
                        reverse --archive-run for one run ID
  --reason REASON       generic public-safe reason saved with
                        include/exclude/archive operations
  --list-excluded       print rankings exclusions and exit unless combined
                        with --rescan
  --include-separate    include runs marked separate/diagnostic in this output
  --adopt ADOPT_CAMPAIGN
                        adopt one validated campaign; arbitrary source
                        directories are refused
  --dry-run             preview campaign adoption without canonical mutation
